previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased is referred to as female (her daughter, the wife).

accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'Spouse' covers only the husband; the co-accused was a friend, which is omitted.

offence_category.reason: Charge and conviction were for murder.

statutory_provisions.reason: Trial court convicted under Section 302 IPC, as the judgment states.

weapon.quote: died in a fire caused by kerosene oil
weapon.reason: The judgment refers to kerosene oil causing the fire, so 'None mentioned' is contradicted.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness testimony, medical (post-mortem), inquest, motive corroboration by mother's testimony
evidence_type.quote: PW-7 the doctor, Khairuz Zaman Choudhary, who had carried out the post-mortem examination
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness and medical evidence are correct; 'recovery' is not mentioned, and inquest and motive evidence are omitted.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Crime truly horrendous; murder committed in matrimonial house; aggravating circumstances held to outweigh mitigating ones
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment identifies the horrendous nature and matrimonial-house setting as aggravating, so 'None noted' is contradicted.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Mitigating circumstances are not specified in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted both, death for Mission Suklabaidhya and life for Uttam Chakraborty.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court confirmed the death sentence (death reference) and dismissed Criminal Appeal No. 212/2005
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court, by the impugned judgment, confirmed the death reference and dismissed the Criminal Appeal.
high_court_outcome.reason: The judgment states the High Court outcome explicitly, so 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeals partly allowed: Uttam Chakraborty acquitted; Mission Suklabaidhya's conviction maintained with death sentence commuted to life
final_outcome.quote: set aside his conviction and sentence and direct that he be set free
final_outcome.reason: 'Acquitted' applies only to Uttam; the husband's conviction was upheld with sentence commuted.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Murder under s.302 IPC by accused-husband Mission Suklabaidhya
offence_finally_established.quote: though the conviction of Mission Suklabaidhya needs to be maintained
offence_finally_established.reason: The husband's murder conviction was maintained, so 'None' is contradicted.

imprisonment_type.quote: the death sentence awarded should be commuted to life imprisonment
imprisonment_type.reason: Husband's sentence was commuted to life imprisonment; 'none' is contradicted.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life imprisonment has no stated term in years; null is appropriate.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Deceased's mother (PW-5) was told her daughter fell ill and went to the police station; co-accused Uttam was seen present, not the husband
neutral_facts.quote: went to the house of Nioti Das PW-1, the mother of the deceased
neutral_facts.reason: Facts wrongly call the informed person the domestic help's mother and say the husband was present; the judgment says Uttam was present.

offence_severity.correct_value: Not stated (sentences imposed: death for husband, life for co-accused; statutory range not stated)
offence_severity.quote: awarded the death penalty, Uttam Chakraborty was ordered to undergo imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: Statutory minimum and maximum are not stated in the judgment; they come from outside knowledge.

attempt_completion.reason: The deceased died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Burn death, eight-month foetus, and abdominal cut with foetus removed are all stated.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence charged (murder under s.302 IPC); conviction upheld for husband, co-accused acquitted
number_of_offences.quote: the appellants were brought to trial on a charge of murder
number_of_offences.reason: Only one charge of murder is stated; 'two offences charged' is not supported.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or financial loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.quote: the very material circumstance that the murder had been committed in the matrimonial house of the couple
premeditation_planning.reason: The court made no premeditation or planning finding; it only noted motive and the matrimonial-house location.

motive.correct_value: Illicit relationship between accused-husband and domestic help PW-1, which the deceased discovered and objected to
motive.quote: Mission Suklabaidhya and PW-1 developed an illicit relationship and when this was discovered by the deceased
motive.reason: The illicit relationship was between the husband and the domestic help, not the deceased; the value misstates the parties.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on PW-6's evidence as primary basis for conviction, while doubting capital sentence on it.

witness_credibility.reason: Judgment says PW-6's credibility was not doubted but caution was needed for capital sentence.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct is recorded in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence night of 13/14 April 2004; High Court judgment 26.04.2006; Supreme Court decision 6 April 2010; trial court date not stated
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment & Order dated 26.04.2006 of the Gauhati High Court
trial_duration.reason: 26.04.2006 is the High Court date; the trial court judgment date is not stated.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.reason: FIR lodged, investigation completed, and trial followed; supported by the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.correct_value: SC commuted husband Mission Suklabaidhya's death sentence to life; Uttam Chakraborty's conviction and sentence set aside
appeal_history.quote: set aside his conviction and sentence and direct that he be set free
appeal_history.reason: Value wrongly says death was commuted for Uttam and that the co-accused's conviction was set aside, reversing the parties.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution relied on PW-6, PW-1 (later resiled), PW-4, PW-5 (motive), PW-2 inquest and PW-7 post-mortem evidence
prosecution_argument.quote: The prosecution relied primarily on the evidence of PW-6 Marjon Suklabaidhya
prosecution_argument.reason: Omits the other witnesses and medical evidence relied on; PW-1 later resiled, which the value does not mention.

defence_argument.reason: The judgment does not record any defence arguments.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the Suresh principle that child witness evidence is not safe enough for a capital sentence.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Suresh (1981) 2 SCC 569 and Raja Ram Yadav (1996) 9 SCC 287 are both cited.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court found capital sentence imprudent based on the child witness's statement, consistent with the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Horrendous nature is an aggravating point, not mitigation; the judgment does not identify mitigating factors or the husband as primary perpetrator.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Crime truly horrendous; murder committed in the matrimonial house of the couple
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: the murder had been committed in the matrimonial house of the couple
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Judgment treats the horrendous crime and matrimonial-house setting as aggravating, not 'None'.

other_sentence_order.reason: Co-accused acquitted as there was absolutely no evidence connecting him to the murder.
